justification.weights: Derived through Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) balancing operational timeliness (20%), technical report quality (20%), and regulatory compliance (20%) as primary pillars, with efficiency (15%), historical renewal (15%), and capacity scale (10%) as secondary pillars.
justification.thresholds: Empanelled renewal threshold of 70.0 corresponds to standard B+ tier regulatory competence. Review threshold of 50.0 triggers mandatory remedial inspection before empanelment revocation.
